scope: Iris source RRD issue selection and scalar control templates; not a complete timing model

alu_uses.description: wxd excludes mem/div/mul/CSR/FP/RoCC/jalr/vector; JAL is not excluded

integer_hazards.description: Older integer scoreboard/bypass hazards plus same-packet RAW/WAW. x0 suppresses final dependency hazards. X->M depends on MEM lane1 not already retaining a late ALU. Same-packet branch/config consumers cannot forward. Raw field hits can retime unused operands. ALU-producer WAW is permitted; memory-producer WAW needs LateALU.

packet_limits.description: Pipe0-only classes, one memory/branch/config per packet, in-order prefix, CSR/system/exception youngest, conditional fence drain. Fence need not be youngest.

frontend_metadata.description: Predicted next-PC tags can reserve branch port even on non-CFI. Small-forward branch heuristic uses displacement4 for RVC or6 for full instruction, when prediction tag absent; only compressed ALU shadow can use lane1.

branch_resolution.value: MEM stage; misprediction flushes RRD/EX and may kill younger packet lanes

retirement.description: COM retire count is PopCount of nonexception/nonreplay/nonkilled lanes. LateALU result written in WB; miss requires replay. Interrupt/trap/CSR flush precision cannot be approximated by unconditional execution of both candidate handlers.

internal_latency_parameters.interpretation: Structural source parameters only; not total issue-to-retirement or calibrated cycles
